messages:
sara: Quick sync request — CloudHarbor wants Valencia (es-east1) live in AWS Marketplace + Dedicated by May 20. They need initial quota + KMS + legal review for co-brand announcement. Timeline ~6w. @olivia can you confirm requirements? Link: https://redwood.docs/regions/valencia

olivia (CloudHarbor): Yes — AMI listing, marketplace entitlement, and an initial pool of 8 A100 GPUs. Legal needs a short SLA blurb and logo usage rights. Prefer launch 2026-05-20. We can do a joint PR but need 72h review window.

sara: Good. Ops + infra, can you call out exact SKU + networking needs so I can include in the partner packet?

dylan: From infra side: want exact instance family (p4d vs p4de) and expected steady-state RPS. Also need VPC peering plan and KMS key ARN.

kevin: Sales note — 3 enterprise beta customers in EMEA waiting on a low-latency region. If we hit <60ms we'll convert them. Target beta throughput ~200 req/s.

marketplace-bot: Marketplace checklist created: https://marketplace.redwood/valencia/checklist — outstanding: entitlement, billing mapping, KMS test, marketing assets. Ref MP-4521.

olivia (CloudHarbor): Confirming p4d/p4de options — we prefer p4de if provider quota permits. We'll initially request 8 GPUs, plan to burst to 24 within 2 weeks of launch.

sara: Proposed plan: initial commit 8xA100 (8 GPUs), autoscale target to 24 GPUs. Quota request: 8 -> 24. KMS key: prod-rw-key-valencia. Legal: assign @legal-team for co-announcement and MSA check. Weekly sync Friday 10am PT. :thumbsup:

legal-team: Assigned case RWD-VAL-2026. Need partner signed MSA + approved marketing copy + logos. Please upload to the case doc.

dylan: Ops action items: NLB + healthcheck + autoscale config. Example snippet for rollout plan:

```
autoscale:
  min_instances: 1
  max_instances: 3
  gpus_per_instance: 4
  instance_type: p4d.24xlarge
```

Also opened quota ticket with cloud provider (INC-712233). ETA ~3 business days for GPU quota. Opened KMS request KMS-98921.

olivia (CloudHarbor): We'll validate p4de availability and revert by EOD Monday. Logos + one-paragraph partner copy coming then.

kevin: I'll compile beta customer list and expected ARR uplift, share in #partnerships today.

marketplace-bot: Entitlement request submitted to marketplace team (MP-4521). Billing mapping task assigned.

sara: If quota + KMS + legal are green, aim to have partner announcement draft ready by 2026-05-13 to allow 72h review window before May 20 launch.

legal-team: Received assets will be reviewed. Will flag any issues by Wednesday.

dylan: Only blocker is p4de quota confirmation; everything else looks OK.

sara: Thanks everyone — action owners: @dylan (quota + infra), @legal-team (MSA + copy), @kevin (customers), @olivia (assets). Weekly check-in Friday 10am PT.

olivia (CloudHarbor): Thanks — sending assets Monday. :partyparrot:
